products.name: Everyday Crew Tee
products.short: The tee you reach for first. Combed ringspun cotton, a collar that keeps its shape and a fit that sits just right.
products.highlight: Just enough weight to drape well without feeling heavy.

products.name: Sunset Graphic Tee
products.short: A retro sunset screen-printed with soft-hand water-based inks, so the print feels like part of the fabric.
products.highlight: Water-based print that will not crack or peel.

products.name: Summit Graphic Tee
products.short: A clean ridge line and a tiny sun, printed in small batches on our softest midweight cotton.
products.highlight: Water-based print that will not crack or peel.

products.name: Daisy Graphic Tee
products.short: Hand-drawn daisies on a tee soft enough for every day. Cheerful without trying too hard.
products.highlight: Water-based print that will not crack or peel.

products.name: Pocket Tee
products.short: A sturdier heavyweight tee with a reinforced chest pocket and a relaxed, boxy fit.
products.highlight: Dense 240 gsm jersey with a structured drape.

products.name: Long Sleeve Tee
products.short: Everything you like about the Everyday Crew with full sleeves and ribbed cuffs that stay put.
products.highlight: Ribbed cuffs keep sleeves where you push them.

products.name: V-Neck Tee
products.short: A lighter jersey and an easy V collar that layers neatly under anything.
products.highlight: Airy 150 gsm jersey for warm days and layering.

products.name: Active Tee
products.short: A quick-drying cotton blend that moves with you on runs, rides and everything after.

products.name: Classic Dad Cap
products.short: Garment-washed cotton twill with a soft crown, curved brim and a brass buckle that adjusts in seconds.
products.highlight: Pre-washed so it feels broken in from day one.

products.name: Snapback Cap
products.short: A structured six-panel crown with a flat brim and a classic snap closure.
products.highlight: Firm front panels hold their shape.

products.name: Cord Camp Cap
products.short: Soft wide-wale corduroy in a packable five-panel shape with a short brim.
products.highlight: Folds flat into a pocket and springs back.

products.name: Rib Knit Beanie
products.short: A chunky rib knit with a deep cuff you can wear tall or pulled down low.
products.highlight: Stretchy rib that never feels tight.

products.name: Heavyweight Hoodie
products.short: Brushed-back fleece, a lined hood and a roomy kangaroo pocket. Built for cold mornings.
products.highlight: 400 gsm brushed fleece with a double-lined hood.

products.name: Crewneck Sweatshirt
products.short: The same heavyweight fleece as our hoodie in a clean crew neck with ribbed side panels.
products.highlight: 400 gsm brushed fleece that keeps its shape.

products.name: Ribbed Crew Socks
products.short: Cushioned footbeds, a seamless toe and a ribbed cuff that stays up without squeezing.
products.highlight: Cushioned sole with a seamless toe.
